# YomVezman 0.6.0 preview
App 0.6.0 (6) for Apple silicon, macOS 14 or later. Testing prerelease; not an App Store-approved release.
- Stop lookup returns location fields to manual editing without closing the map. - Canceled location requests cannot overwrite a newer selection. - Invalid map coordinates and lookup results cannot reuse an old usable draft. - Repeated authorization callbacks no longer request duplicate location fixes. - Expanded tests for offline failure, saved-data fallback, fresh retry and location isolation across all calendar panels.
72 live-enabled automated tests pass. Independent Swift review has no blockers. Native checks passed current-location and map-center draft lookup, Cancel without saving, invalid timezone rejection/correction and saving/loading calendar data. Real permission denial, native Stop-button activation, packaged network-outage/recovery, arbitrary map clicks and earlier menu-only/keyboard acceptance remain unverified. Automated simulations do not establish native acceptance. Keep Dock mode enabled for the most thoroughly exercised launch path.
Developer ID signed, notarized and stapled. Notarization is a security check, not App Store approval or religious certification.
From 0.4.0 or later use Check for Updates → Update → Install Update → Install and Relaunch. Older versions require one manual DMG installation. Your installed app is not changed by publication.
